definitions.clavicular head of pectoralis major musc: A muscle head that forms the superior portion of the pectoralis major, originating from the anterior surface of the medial half of the clavicle and converging with the sternocostal head to insert via a common tendon onto the lateral lip of the intertubercular groove of the humerus.
definitions.sternocostal head of pectoralis major mu: A muscle head that forms the larger inferior portion of the pectoralis major, originating from the anterior surface of the sternum, the superior six costal cartilages, and the aponeurosis of the external oblique muscle, and inserting together with the clavicular head onto the lateral lip of the intertubercular groove of the humerus.
